# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 stable** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, and safer pixel and native-object lifetimes. It adds backend-neutral asynchronous pixel reads, restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, and updates native assets across supported platforms.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome m152 and includes subsequent m151 and m152 stability and servicing fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel reads added** — SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral RequestReadPixels support for asynchronous pixel readback. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native object and pixel-source lifetimes corrected** — Fixes use-after-free paths in SKRegion iteration and SKPixmap subset operations, plus a raster-image pixel-buffer leak on creation failure. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Runtime-effect uniform buffers are replaced safely** — Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the prior uniform buffer. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))
- **HarfBuzz blob conversion no longer leaks stream assets** — Converting non-memory-backed streams to HarfBuzz blobs now releases the native stream asset. ([#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))

## Platform

- **Vulkan Silk.NET package restored** — Restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and expands Vulkan validation to Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Native platform assets improved** — Adds Apple native symbol packages, makes Android symbol identity deterministic, and provides FreeType font support for Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Updates HarfBuzzSharp packaging and documentation, improves shaping and tag-formatting performance, and fixes stream-backed blob lifetime handling.
